sub_sector.value: Asphalt roofing shingles; building insulation; interior and exterior doors

manufacturing_type.detail: Processes materials into shingles, insulation and glass nonwoven veils, and assembles doors as individual units.

production_model.detail: Offers standard designer shingles and tailors glass nonwoven veils and facers to customer needs.

product_complexity.detail: Shingles use patented SureNail technology, and glass facers improve moisture resistance, impact resistance and dimensional stability.

production_role.detail: Makes branded roofing, insulation and doors and supplies glass facers and backers for ceiling tiles and gypsum boards.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves building construction through roofing, insulation and doors, and supplies nonwovens for flooring, interiors and industrial applications.

notes: Make-to-stock production is inferred from the standard shingle line.
